title: Pressure trend
description: Essential: The response must state that the pressure exerted by the block on the inclined plane decreases during the motion.

title: Detachment speed
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for the speed when leaving the plane must be v = (mg cosθ)/(qB).

title: Time on incline
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for the time on the plane must be t = m/(qB tanθ).

title: Lorentz force role
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the Lorentz force (qvB) and explain its role in reducing the normal force as speed increases.

title: Detachment condition
description: Important: The solution must identify the correct detachment condition: when the magnetic force balances the normal component of gravity (qvB = mg cosθ).

title: Kinematic setup
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply kinematics for constant acceleration (a = g sinθ) along the incline to relate speed, time, and distance.

title: Direction of forces
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the direction of the Lorentz force is incorrect (e.g., not perpendicular to both velocity and B-field, or wrong sign).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Award if the solution explicitly checks or discusses the dimensional consistency of the final expressions.
